text:
No, pothos isn't safe for cats. It's on our not-pet-safe list, so we'd recommend keeping it away from them.

If you'd like a plant that's safe for pets, these are on our pet-safe list:
- Calathea
- Spider plant
- Parlour palm
- Boston fern
- Peperomia

If your cat may have chewed or eaten any part of a pothos, contact a vet or an animal poison control service right away, before anything else.

I don't have more detailed information on specific symptoms or treatment, so your vet is the best source for that.
